te: After a campaign by the writer Voltaire, judges in Paris posthumously exonerate Jean Calas of murdering his son. Calas …
dz: 在作家伏尔泰的一次运动后,巴黎的法官们事后免除了让·卡拉斯谋杀他儿子的罪名. 卡拉斯在1762年因罪名被拷打并被处死,尽管他的儿子可能实际上已经死于自杀.
de: After a campaign by the writer Voltaire, judges in Paris posthumously exonerate Jean Calas of murdering his son. Calas had been tortured and executed in 1762 on the charge, though his son may have actually died by suicide.

t: 英国议会通过"印花法",引入了对其美国殖民地直接征收的税.
te: The British Parliament passes the Stamp Act that introduces a tax to be levied directly on its American colonies.
dz: 英国议会通过"印花法",引入了对其美国殖民地直接征收的税.
de: The British Parliament passes the Stamp Act that introduces a tax to be levied directly on its American colonies.

t: 大不列颠通过了"限制法"(Quartering Act),要求十三殖民地驻有英国军队.
te: Great Britain passes the Quartering Act, which requires the Thirteen Colonies to house British troops.
dz: 大不列颠通过了"限制法"(Quartering Act),要求十三殖民地驻有英国军队.
de: Great Britain passes the Quartering Act, which requires the Thirteen Colonies to house British troops.

dz: HMS胜利号在肯特的查塔姆码头发射. 她直到1778年才受委托.
de: HMS Victory is launched at Chatham Dockyard, Kent. She is not commissioned until 1778.

de: Treaty of Allahabad is signed. The Treaty marks the political and constitutional involvement and the beginning of Company rule in India.

te: The British Parliament enacts the Stamp Act on the Thirteen Colonies in order to help pay for British military operatio…
dz: 英国议会颁布"十三殖民地印花法"来帮助支付英国在北美的军事行动.
de: The British Parliament enacts the Stamp Act on the Thirteen Colonies in order to help pay for British military operations in North America.
